steps.content:
<size=45>Northwild gales ring sharp on steel,

a thousand frozen peaks lie hushed and still.

Behold the divine arts that quell the snow,

granting the mortals a springtime glow.</size>

All the world admires Eastia, a land with no wants for mines and war, a realm untainted by the worldly chaos. It relies solely on its people's steadfast resolve and unwavering will. Seers channel the living's collective wishes to ward off disasters and preserve peace. Yet little does the world know, in Eastia, there exists such a place...

This territory has neither deity-channeling seers nor land-nourishing blessed energy. Only endless disasters and raging snowstorms year after year, leaving its soil lifeless and desolate. This place is the frozen earth beneath your very feet—Northwild.
[Small CG: Folk, Children]

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Ah—choo! I, I know! My ma makes me say it every day: "The third thatched hut of Wu Lane, Ping'an Town, right under Mount Fuyun, Northwild, Eastia!"

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: That's 'cause you can't read and your ma's worried you'll get buried in the snow and can't find your way home! This way, the town patrol can dig you out and bring you back. Stop interrupting! I heard today's story is the best one they save only for special times!

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: What could be so amazing about this backwater mountain valley of ours... Oh! I know what it is!

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: That's right! The ones you can't stop babbling about even in your dreams, the coolest people from our hometown, who you can find nowhere else but in Northwild...

steps.speaker: Child A & Child B
steps.content: The martial heroes!

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: You're not entirely wrong. But even I've grown sick of the clichéd hero's moral awakening and journey into martial arts. Why don't we try something different today? Have you ever heard of Northsnow Manor?

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Look up and behold: Deep within the clouds, atop Mount Fuyun, this mysterious manor has been hidden in the snow for years. Legend tells that it was once a place of ethereal peace and beauty, but alas, its fame has faded after years of snowstorms, and no one has so much as glimpsed its true form since.

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: But recently, rumors have begun to spread throughout Northwild's martial world. They say the manor's current master is none other than a frail, sickly maiden. What's more, this young manor master is said to possess a legendary codex called the Snowquell Arts...

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Once word spreads, those usually elusive martial heroes all begin to stir. Some worry this may break the decades-old equilibrium of Northwild's martial world, while others are simply curious to catch a glimpse of the suddenly resurfaced Northsnow Manor.

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: By now, all these martial heroes should have already gathered at the foot of the mountain...

steps.speaker: Martial Artist
steps.content: Damn this weather! If I'd known how bad the snow would be, I would never have come!

steps.speaker: Martial Artist
steps.content: Bring me some liquor, lad!

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: My apologies, sir, but our humble establishment is so busy today that I'm afraid we don't have any empty seats left for...

steps.speaker: Martial Artist
steps.content: Then tell those sightless bastards to make room for me! And if any of them refuse, tell them who I am and make them think twice!

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: And... sir, may I ask who you are?
[Small CG: Folk, Broken Bowl]

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: A reckless monk who dines on wine and meat, whose iron fists crush all evil, merciless and unforgiving! It is none other than the "Delightful Forest Master," Jiewubei.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: I know him! Ma has told me about him! They say he's so strong that he can send someone from one end of an alley to the other with a punch!

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: He's that powerful? Then why should anyone fear that dangerous manor and mysterious master with him around?

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: But courage alone is not enough. None of those who have gathered at the foot of Mount Fuyun with their various ambitions are ordinary folk!
[Small CG: Inn, Weapons]

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Turning wealth in his palm like clouds and rain, he exhausts his fortune to aid the common folk. Here we have Young Master Shen Wanchou, also known as "Golden Brocade," a magnanimous merchant who delights in righteous deeds and helping those in a bind.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Well, easy there! What's the big fuss? Now, anyone willing to give up their seat for the Master gets a silver ingot! Tonight, all the food and drink in this inn is on me! Just do me this favor, how about it?

steps.speaker: Jiewubei
steps.content: Hmph! Are you mocking me...? Don't think that I don't know what you're scheming, lad!

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Oh, he doesn't sound too glad about the offer! They're not gonna fight, are they?

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Not so fast. As long as the Phoenix Princess Ji Guining is present, peace is always guaranteed. Listening in silence, the lady of imperial blood continues the story with her elegance and eloquence...

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Young Master Brocade's kind intentions are truly admirable, but the martial heroes value their dignity above all, and particularly despise anything that smacks of charity. Master Wubei, if it pleases you, you're more than welcome to join me at my table.

steps.speaker: Martial Artist
steps.content: Haha... Who would have thought that the Snowquell Arts would draw out even the renowned Lady Ji, who rarely leaves her pipa pavilion. Forgive an old man for speaking out of turn, but these bitter mountain snows are hardly good for your leg condition.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: And who is this now?

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Yin Yansheng the "Immortal Healer"! He diagnoses and treats sickness with his mad words and skillful hands, bargaining with ghosts and gods for mortal life!

steps.speaker: Martial Artist
steps.content: The legendary Doctor Yin! I have long admired your reputation. To be able to accompany the Immortal Healer to Northsnow Manor... This is truly an honor for someone with my humble medical skills.

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: "Silver Needle Gentleman" Xu Shen! For ten years he sharpened his rusted needles, only to one day aim them at the dragon's gate. With scaled armor hidden under scholar robes, he is a clap of thunder lurking beneath the calm surface!

steps.speaker: Martial Artist
steps.content: Tsk, I didn't bring you here to watch you keep up this scholarly act. You've stumbled into the martial world now, and you must understand that here we care less about seniority than strength and character. Everyone here is of great talent. I, Ma Ling, shall raise the first toast to you all!

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: "General Invincible" Ma Ling! A hero of humble origins, she rallies elite fighters with her loyal heart and righteous spirit. Steady as a ceaseless river, she holds her halberd high, but her spirits higher, even across mountain passes!
[Small CG: Folk Group Portrait]

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: One hero, two heroes, three... Wow, this Northsnow Manor sure is something else, to be able to summon all these legendary figures from the storybooks!

steps.speaker: Child B
steps.content: That "codex"... Um... cold eggs? Can they actually taste so good? Better than the eggs from Auntie Wang's hens?

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Well, one can only find out by going there and seeing for oneself, right?

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Shuang'er is going too? To that manor? To Northsnow Manor?!

The children listening to the story all crowd around at once, chattering excitedly. Among them, only one person stands out. A twentysomething who stands far off with arms crossed, having listened to the entire tale in silence.

Fitted clothes, tied-up hair, a sheathed sword. Definitely not a familiar face from Ping'an Town. Shuang'er glimpses the person thoughtfully but doesn't let her expression reveal anything, continuing to respond.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Of course! After all, I am a registered disciple of Ping'an Town's Beggar Clan, as well as the unofficial chief storyteller for the Martial World Gazette. I must attend such a rare martial world event to bring back the freshest, first-hand stories for everyone!

With that, she taps her wooden stick against the edge of her broken bowl with a sharp clink, bringing today's tale to a close. When she looks up again, the unfamiliar figure is already dwindling, heading toward Mount Fuyun.
[Inn]

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: Oh, honored guest, I'm afraid you've come at a bad time. Our humble establishment is truly full today...
No problem. I just need a place to shelter from the snow. I hope that won't be too much trouble for you?
The young traveler has trudged through snow all the way up to the mountainside, finally finding the inn the storyteller described, where the martial heroes have gathered.
The attendant doesn't turn the polite guest away and simply pours a pot of hot tea. Just as he is about to turn and attend to other guests, he gets called back.
Excuse me, I'd like to ask about something. How much longer does it take to get to <color=#fb9259>Northsnow Manor</color> from here?
The moment Northsnow Manor is mentioned, the inn falls completely silent.
All eyes fall upon the young traveler.
